metadata.description: Xtensa ESP32-S3 ESP-IDF, software atomics: the stock spec with S32C1I disabled, so LLVM lowers every atomic to an __atomic_* libcall. ESP-IDF implements them with S32C1I for internal RAM and a lock for PSRAM, where S32C1I does not work (STDATOMIC_S32C1I_SPIRAM_WORKAROUND); 64-bit atomics as in the parent spec
